_comment: Pins for sim/digital-pnr/harness/pnr-and-verify.py (issue #166). The harness refuses to run (or to mint a record) when the live tools/PDK/input differ, unless --allow-tool-drift is given, in which case the drift is written into the record.
klt: the build reported by `klt --version` on the loom workers (provisioned from 2AMLogic/2am infra/aws/loom-worker/); klt place-and-route/sta/lvs/extract/drc contracts used here are the 0.6.0 ones.
openroad: `openroad -version` of the digest-pinned openroad/orfs container wrapper installed at ~/.local/bin/openroad (image digest recorded below). klt runs it as a subprocess.

The input netlist is the committed, klt-equiv-proven 50 kHz-constrained synthesis output of sim/digital-synthesis/records/20260910-001436-a4c3194 (its klt content_hash is that record's netlist_content_hash_input).
